fit: Fig fruit and gastrointestinal outcomes in a randomized IBS trial
assessment: The publisher excerpt verifies 142 completers out of 150 randomized and four withdrawals from the fig group. Fig and flixweed groups reported better bowel symptom frequency than usual diet. Pain severity and C-reactive protein did not clearly differ. The discussion suggests dried fruit and the intervention methods remain open. The trial reports no Parkinson visual event measure. PMID and NCT02559245 represent one result family.
